title: Homogeneity of the derivation chain under the calibration discipline
html:
Homogeneity of the chain

Induction along the 19-link derivation chain. At each step:

  • Base. The categorical action \mathfrak{S} = \mathrm{tr}(\Phi) is a \mathbb{Q}(q)-valued endomorphism trace (categorical-action) — dimensionless, living in H^1.
  • Frobenius pairing. Preserves \mathbb{Q}(q)-rationality (frobenius-pairing); identifies A \cong A^\vee in H^0 \oplus H^1.
  • Mass identity. Introduces the Frobenius norm \|\cdot\| on A (mass-identity) — the norm is itself a \mathbb{Q}(q)-valued Markov-trace expression in H^0, not an Archimedean absolute value. The single H^0 insertion is multiplied by m_e at the reporting step.
  • Hecke descent. \Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta) \in H_n(q) is a \mathbb{Q}(q)-element of the Hecke algebra (hecke-mass-element).
  • Markov trace. \mathrm{tr}_M : H_n(q) \to \mathbb{Q}(q) (jones-markov-trace).
  • Tower. The mass-tower formula (mass-endomorphism-tower) is built from Markov-trace expressions, \Phi_q-tower terms, and rational coefficients in z — all in \mathbb{Q}(q).
  • Meson sector. The orthogonal \mathrm{Vol}(\mathrm{Hopf}) = 0 class supplies the single meson scale m_\pi, independent of (m_e, q_0) (the Hopf-link complement has zero hyperbolic volume). \mathfrak{Q}_\beta, the CAL-2 proxy, is computed from m_e and the already-pinned q_0 via the Markov-trace \Delta base at z = q_0^3/(q_0^2+1): 
      \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\Delta} \;=\; \Bigl\lvert \tfrac{h^2}{2} - h\,z \Bigr\rvert\,\frac{m_e}{q_0(q_0-1)(1-\hbar_q^2)}
  \;\approx\; 0.4491\ \text{MeV}\quad(-42.59\%\text{ vs CODATA}),
    with h = q_0 - q_0^{-1} and \hbar_q = 1 - q_0^{-1} (tower-summed E_0; the order-zero form gives 0.4447 MeV; the z = 1 coordinate-sum Form A gives 0.784 MeV, +0.17\%, cos-resummation). The scored value applies the T^3 weight split of the z = q_0^3/(q_0^2+1) trace to the \gamma\gamma base V^3 = (\sigma_0\sigma_1^{-1})^3, giving \mathfrak{Q}_\beta \approx 0.3254 MeV (-58.40\%) (Symbolic Q-value of free neutron decay), while the z = q^3/(q^2+1) c_k ladder remains open. The base uses only fixed scales, so the descent obstruction class (motivic perpetual obstruction theorem) is normalised by the already-fixed scales, not by a fourth input.

The dimensional factors m_e and m_\pi enter only at the final reporting step (tower-binding-energy), multiplying the dimensionless tower expression to give a value in energy units. The composite functional is therefore \mathfrak{m}(X) = m_e^a m_\pi^c \cdot Q_X(q_0) with Q_X \in \mathbb{Q}(q_0) and a, c \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}.

The discipline is a structural assumption, not a derived result — its content is the mass-factorisation hypothesis of the three-calibration discipline, which is assumed, not proved. What the walk above shows is that the assumption is consistent with the chain as far as the chain is realised. Remaining open conjectures along the chain (mass-endomorphism, phi-q-tower-jsj-bridge) do not affect the dimensional-discipline statement: every step that is realised respects m_e^a m_\pi^c \cdot \mathbb{Q}(q_0) homogeneity, and any future closure of the chain inherits this.
